title: Align Benchmark Lab action validation with Viwo proper and add Preferred Action (+1) scoring

sections.what: Make Benchmark Lab (/bench) parse, normalize, and dry-run validate actions using the same ActionNormalizer + handle_take_action rules as Viwo proper, and add a Preferred Action (+1 Score) control to Turn Context.
sections.why: /bench was missing script tags for ActionNormalizer/ActionVerbs/json-utils, stripped structured action fields before normalizing, and called a validate_action_command implementation that checked _VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET before self-contained verbs (falsely rejecting bare relieve, look, and search), failed to bind active_player during item matching, did not split compound commands (use X on Y, put X in Y, give X to Y), and passed unknown verbs via a catch-all return. In addition, users had no way to specify a contextually preferred action for +1 scoring on a turn prompt.
sections.how:
1. Load shared/json-utils.js, agent/action-verbs.generated.js, agent/action-normalizer.js, and agent/response-parser.js in templates/benchmark.html.
2. Update evaluateModelOutput in static/js/benchmark/benchmark.js to repair JSON, preserve full structured action objects (item, target, relation, where, intensity, amount, text) when calling ActionNormalizer.normalizeStructuredAction, run ActionNormalizer.classifyAction, and query POST /api/action/validate.
3. Update validate_action_command and handle_validate_action in routes/action_handlers.py to bind active_player to char_name, evaluate self-contained/optional-target verbs before _VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET, report toilet/latrine fixture presence on relieve, split compound preposition commands matching handle_take_action, and reject unregistered verbs against engine/action_verbs.py (with forward-compatible fallback to engine/actions.py for task-988).
4. Add Preferred Action (+1 Score) input + room-populated datalist in templates/benchmark.html and live re-scoring in static/js/benchmark/benchmark.js.
sections.verify: 1. Run python -m pytest tests/test_benchmark_routes.py -v -> 16/16 passed.\n2. Check zero em-dashes across modified files.

acceptance.text: templates/benchmark.html loads shared/json-utils.js, agent/action-verbs.generated.js, agent/action-normalizer.js, and agent/response-parser.js so /bench uses Viwo's real action normalization and classification pipeline

validate_action_command in routes/action_handlers.py temporarily binds active_player to char_name, evaluates self-contained and optional-target verbs (relieve, look, search, rest, sleep, flee, plan, schedule, goal, obligation, recall, find, hide, wake, release, fix) before _VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET, splits 2-target commands (use X on/in Y, put/place/stow X in/on/under/beside/behind/at Y, give X to Y, steal X from Y, teach X to Y, combine X with Y, attack/intimacy X on region), and rejects unknown verbs via the action verb registry
Benchmark Lab (/bench) Turn Context panel includes a Preferred Action (+1 Score) selector with room-grounded autocomplete suggestions and live re-scoring across model cards and exported JSON
pytest tests/test_benchmark_routes.py passes 16/16 with zero em-dashes

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: /bench (Benchmark Lab Turn Context sidebar and Model Comparison cards)

Current availability: Live in templates/benchmark.html, static/js/benchmark/benchmark.js, and routes/action_handlers.py.

Live verification steps:
1. Open /bench and select a character and optional simulated area.
2. Enter or pick a Preferred Action (+1 Score) in Turn Context (e.g. go hallway, relieve, or examine desk).
3. Run or reroll models; verify self-contained actions (relieve, look, search) and compound actions (use X on Y, put X on Y, give X to Y) validate identically to Viwo proper via ActionNormalizer + POST /api/action/validate, and that matching the preferred action awards +1 in the card Score metric and validation flags.
